data.name: Cosimo
data.gender_notes: Cosimo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word cosmos meaning 'orderly universe'. In Italian tradition, the name Cosimo is associated with wealth, power, and leadership. The name Cosimo carries the meaning “Orderly universe” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Cosimo usually hope their child will grow to embody orderly universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of the divine order in the universe.
data.etymology: Cosimo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Orderly universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cosimo total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: קוסימו
in_hebrew.meaning: קוסימו משמעות שם נוצרי מסדר קוסמס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קוסימו מקורו בשם היווני קוסמאס, שפירושו סדר וסידור, וקשור לקוסמי, שפירושו היקום והסדר האלוהי. השם משמש במסורת הנוצרית ומופיע בקרב קדושים וקוסמולוגים.

in_greek.name: Κοσίμος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κοσίμος προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Κοσμάς, που σημαίνει τάξη, διακόσμηση και συνήθως συνδέεται με την έννοια του κόσμου και της κοσμολογίας. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Κοσίμος συμβολίζει την αρμονία και την οργάνωση σύμφωνα με το θέλημα του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Cosimo
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Cosimo is derived from the Greek name Kosmas, meaning order, arrangement, and cosmos. In Christian tradition, Cosimo signifies harmony and organization according to God's will, reflecting the cosmic order.

in_english.name: Cosimo
in_english.meaning: Order, harmony, and arrangement in the universe
in_english.long_meaning: The name Cosimo originates from the Greek name Kosmas, meaning order and arrangement. It is associated with the concept of cosmos and reflects the harmony and organization of the universe according to Christian tradition. The name symbolizes balance and divine order.

data.cultural_impact: The name Leo is believed to depict strength, courage, and valor in various cultures, particularly in ancient Roman and Greek mythology where it symbolizes the regal and mighty lion.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, Leo represents Saint Leo the Great, a popular and influential Pope in the 5th century, known for his promotion of orthodox beliefs and stability in the Church during uncertain times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Cosimo, meaning "he who is filled with goodness" in Italian, symbolizes the divine grace bestowed upon an individual, nurturing their soul with love and compassion, inspiring them to spread goodness and positivity into the world.

historical_references.reference: Cosimo de' Medici, the elder (1389-1464), was a prominent member of the Medici family and the de facto ruler of Florence during the Early Renaissance.
historical_references.context: Cosimo is best known for his patronage of the arts and his role in the development of the Renaissance in Florence.
